newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs seen steady to up, pork bellies mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs seen steady to up, pork bellies mixed.

text.p: CME hog futures were expected to open steady to 0.150 cent higher while calls on pork bellly futures ranged from 0.150 cent higher to 0.100 lower, livestock analysts said.

Mostly steady to higher cash hog calls and continued strong cash pork product markets were expected to provide early support in hog futures. Pork cutout values were the highest since early October and the rise should prompt packers to seek hogs, analysts said.
However, not all marketing areas appear strong and this could weigh on sentiment, they said.

The lighter-than-projected pace of hog slaughter from the last Hog and Pigs Report and strong product values were expected to support pork belly futures. Futures had shown a technical correction the past couple of days and a neutral out-of-town report would likely encourage modest support following the highest cash belly prices since early October, analysts said.
However, some analysts cited seasonal tendencies for resistance. The demand for bacon declines during the holidays, which are approaching, they added.
